definition: a person whose job is putting out fires
description: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

de.answer: Sie rettet eine Katze von einem Baum.
de.question: Was macht die Feuerwehrfrau?

es.answer: Está salvando a un gato de un árbol.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la bombera?

fr.answer: Elle sauve un chat dans un arbre.
